name: Chasing Whiskers
description:
About This Game

Chasing Whiskers is a student project made by a passionate cat-loving team at Breda University of Applied Sciences. This project has been made over a total of 24 weeks and is close to completion. We'd love to hear what you think so please share your thoughts and feedback to us in our discord or through a review!
Welcome to Catworld!
Play as grandma, on a mission to find her lost cat. You followed it straight through an interdimensional portal into a mystical land made entirely for cats. No wonder it ended up here! With no way home and no leads, helping out the local Cat Café seems like your only option. Ponpon the owner claims to know exactly where your cat is, and he'll tell you, as soon as you run just one more errand...

Spot a cat, dive, and scoop them up! Cats are roaming everywhere in cat world, and some might prove to be a real catch. Find new cats and discover their unique abilities throughout Catworld!

Ponpon knows where your cat is, probably. Help him enough and he clears the way to for you to move deeper into the jungle: new areas, new cats, new secrets. The great Cat Tree is out there somewhere. Ponpon will definitely tell you once you've finished this last errand. This one. For real this time.

Colourful, strange, and completely cat themed. Every corner of the jungle has something going on. Wander far enough and you'll keep finding reasons to stay.

Chasing Whiskers is a cozy adventure for players who love exploring, collecting and catching cats!
short_desc: Catch cats in this cozy adventure game! After falling into Catworld through an interdimensional portal, you must find your missing cat by completing errands for Ponpon, the local Cat Café owner. Chase, catch and collect until you can find your way home! This game is made by students.
